why: Since 2026-08-14 (ticket orient-floor-authors-and-provenance-is-measured) the orient FLOOR authors `refs`, and it authors them as repo-relative PATHS ('cairn/devices/tester'). survey_floor keys the device_census by BARE COMPONENT NAME ('tester') and tests `if ref in roster and ref in rows`. A path never matches, so census_rows is ALWAYS empty and every component ref falls through to ref_exists(), which PASSES — so the hole is silent: the floor reports a healthy-looking packet with refs_found populated and refs_missing empty, and nothing complains. survey's whole deterministic stratum — the MEASURED state (proofs, validations, devices, emit sites) that stage 3 exists to surface — has not fired for any voyage since. Its dial attributes the work to `claude` because claude is in fact doing all of it by hand.

occurrences.instrument: for every berthed orient packet under ~/.cairn/devices/chart/0/packets/, count refs and how many are in set(component_roster(CAIRN_ROOT))
occurrences.population: 350 refs across all berthed orient packets, split by berth day
occurrences.the_break_point: 2026-08-14 — the day the floor became the author. 0 of 40 refs match across 20260814/15/16, where a HAND-written ref matched 17-46% of the time. The regression is the authorship change, not drift.

the_two_ends.author: cairn/devices/builder/machines/orient/orient.py floor_packet() — writes refs as repo-relative paths
the_two_ends.reader: cairn/devices/builder/machines/survey/survey.py survey_floor() — `rows = {r['component']: r for r in census['measured']['components']}` then `if ref in roster and ref in rows`

occurrences.why_it_is_silent: the else-branch is ref_exists(ref, root), which resolves a PATH fine. A component ref is therefore recorded as an ordinary found ref. There is no lane, no population and no complaint for 'this ref IS a component and I failed to find its row'.
occurrences.first_observed: the /chart chain for ticket standing-gates-the-newest-link-and-run-proof-names-its-sink, constrain berth constrain-20260816T121620-dabedfcfabe6.json, survey_floor returned census_rows: [] with refs_found listing 5 tester paths and refs_missing empty
occurrences.not_fixed_here_because: OUT of that ticket's constrain bounds (bounds.in is the tester's own files); widening bounds is Akien's gate, never a silent build-time widening
occurrences.candidate_fix: resolve a ref to a component the way the census itself does, at ONE address, rather than two ends each spelling it — the roster/census key and the floor's ref spelling must come from a single resolver. Adding a path->name mapping at the reader would fix the symptom and leave the two spellings free to drift again.
